SessionStart.command: command -v ov-hook >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec ov-hook session-start antigravity || exec bash ./tools/ov.sh hook session-start antigravity

PreInvocation.command: command -v ov-hook >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec ov-hook pre-invocation antigravity || exec bash ./tools/ov.sh hook pre-invocation antigravity

Stop.command: command -v ov-hook >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec ov-hook stop antigravity || exec bash ./tools/ov.sh hook stop antigravity
